phase: G1.0 — Interior LN Relation Feasibility / Shadow

relationOccurrenceDefinition.identity: one original parent LN + one exact strict-interior MapperEvidenceProfile anchor + one original LN witness whose head is the same anchor

structuralPopulation: all original-only strict interior anchors and their same-occurrence complete LN witnesses before production thresholds, ranking or cap

holdoutRules.query: keymode + exact parent duration + exact anchor offset from parent start + AnchorKind
holdoutRules.jointResult: InteriorEndRelation + exact duration from anchor + exact offset from parent end

sameOccurrenceRule: anchor, child head and endpoint must come from the same original LN witness; marginal values from different observations never form a complete relation
marginalVsJointRule: marginal duration and endpoint support are reported independently from exact same-occurrence joint support
c11Role: development/discovery corpus only; observed in C11 is not independent external validation

outcomeCriteria.A: exact representation; marginal/joint separation; exact provenance; zero leakage/RNG/behavior drift; a relation class in more than one C11 family; real held-out comparable cases; alternatives without selector; bounded future G1 design scope
outcomeCriteria.B: exact representation works but evidence is too sparse, concentrated, alternative-dominated, legacy-gate-dependent or otherwise insufficient for a useful bounded intervention
outcomeCriteria.C: identity requires unauthorized inference/fuzzy matching, leakage is intrinsic, behavior/RNG changes, synthetic evidence contaminates style, or frequency becomes authority
